reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Storage version of `externalsecrets.external-secrets.io` changes v1beta1 → v1", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: migration-required

consequence.statement: Existing ExternalSecret objects stay stored as v1beta1 until rewritten; the operator must re-write all objects and update status.storedVersions before a later release removes v1beta1.
consequence.remediation: Run a storage version migration (re-write all ExternalSecret objects) and update status.storedVersions.

proposed.statement: The ExternalSecret CRD's v1beta1 version stops being the storage version (true → false), so objects stay stored as v1beta1 until rewritten and a storage version migration is needed before v1beta1 is removed.
